title: What the Stream Wrote: Byte Order, a Float That Took Eight Bytes, and a String That Is Not the Bytes You Meant
fallback: This lesson is about what QDataStream writes, so it needs Qt. Lesson 08-01 writes the same sort of frame by hand, one byte at a time, which is the version that needs nothing. Without Qt, do 08-01 and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a reading written to and read from a documented byte layout with a QDataStream, refusing frames that are short, long or do not end where they should
